title: 第2527章 东西我取出来了第2526章 争着招揽
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: “唉，玲珑族长不必挂怀，”
赢天阙率先开口，赤红的双眼中惋惜之色一闪而过，随即被豪爽掩盖，大手一挥，
“来日方长！黑魔王庭又不会跑了。下次开启，我赢氏一族必倾尽全族之力相助，把它带出来！”
“正是此理！”
云馨儿紧随其后，雍容的脸上满是诚挚。
“我云氏一族也责无旁贷。玲珑族长莫要因此郁结于心，机缘之事，强求不得。”
她声音温婉，仿佛真心实意地宽慰。
“没错！”
“古神九脉，同气连枝！”
“下次我等定当鼎力相助！”
其余几位族长纷纷附和，声音洪亮，神情恳切。
一时间，场面充满了“同仇敌忾”、“守望相助”的热烈气氛，仿佛刚才为争夺风云扬六人几乎撕破脸皮的并非他们。
只是那眼底深处一闪而逝的轻松，甚至是一丝不易察觉的庆幸，又如何瞒得过姬玲珑与姜伊人这等人物？
姬玲珑面上维持着淡淡的失落，微微颔首：
“多谢诸位族长高义。”
心中却是一片冷然。
几番虚情假意的寒暄过后，云船恰好抵达几处空间节点。
皇太极、赢天阙等人纷纷起身告辞，带着各自族中的天骄，化作流光投向不同的方向。
热闹的云船瞬间清冷下来，只剩下姬氏一脉的人马，以及静立一旁的姜伊人。
“走吧，先回族内。”
姬玲珑的声音恢复了惯常的清冷，听不出喜怒。
一位姬氏长老立刻祭出一艘通体玄黑、形如巨梭的云船，船身镌刻着繁复的防御魔纹，散发出沉稳厚重的空间波动。
众人鱼贯登船。
“伊人，走吧，上去聊。”
姬玲珑侧身，对姜伊人做了个请的手势。
姜伊人月白长裙纤尘不染，目光却如凝霜般落在姬玲珑脸上。
那眼神锐利如剑，带着毫不掩饰的质问与一丝冰冷的怒意。
她周身的气息都沉凝了几分。
姬玲珑承受着那刺人的目光，神色依旧平静，只是袖中的手指微微蜷紧。
姜伊人终究没有当场发作。
她一言不发，足尖轻点，身影已如一片流云般飘上云船。
姬玲珑紧随其后。
上了云船之后，姬玲珑便带着姜伊人朝着船舱走去。
而就在两人即将踏入主舱门的一刹那。
姬玲珑的脚步微不可察地一顿，背脊瞬间绷直。
姜伊人月白长袖下的手，指尖也轻轻颤动了一下。
两人脸上的线条在幽蓝光线下似乎柔和了一瞬，眼底深处有狂喜的光芒爆闪，却又在电光石火间被强行压下，如同从未出现过。
她们甚至没有交换眼神，只是步伐节奏没有丝毫紊乱地继续前行，身影没入舱门后的阴影之中。
content_en:
"Oh, there is no need to worry about Chief Linglong,"
Ying Tianque spoke first, a look of regret flashed across his red eyes, and then was covered up by his generosity, and with a wave of his hand,
"The days are long! The Dark Lord's Court will not escape again. Next time it opens, I, the Ying clan, will do our best to help and bring it out!"
"Exactly this!"
Yun Xiner followed closely behind, her graceful face full of sincerity.
"We, the Yun clan, have no shirk in our responsibility. Chief Linglong, please don't be upset about this. You can't force things by chance."
Her voice was gentle, as if she was genuinely relieved.
"That's right!"
"The nine veins of the ancient god are connected with the same energy!"
"I will definitely help you next time!"
The other clan leaders all echoed, with loud voices and sincere expressions.
For a time, the scene was filled with a warm atmosphere of "sharing the same hatred" and "watching and helping each other", as if they were not the ones who had almost fought for Fengyun Yang just now.
Just the flash of relief deep in the eyes, and even a trace of imperceptible happiness, how could it be hidden from people like Ji Linglong and Jiang Yiren?
Ji Linglong maintained a hint of disappointment on her face and nodded slightly:
"Thank you very much, clan leaders Gao Yi."
There was a feeling of indifference in my heart.
After several false greetings, Yun Chuan happened to arrive at several space nodes.
Huang Taiji, Ying Tianque and others stood up to say goodbye, taking the geniuses of their respective clans and turning them into streams of light in different directions.
The bustling Yunzhou suddenly became deserted, leaving only the people of Ji's lineage and Jiang Yiren standing quietly aside.
"Let's go, go back to the clan first."
Ji Linglong's voice returned to its usual cold tone, with no hint of emotion or anger.
An elder of the Ji family immediately launched a cloud ship that was completely black and shaped like a giant shuttle. The hull was engraved with complex defensive magic patterns and emitted steady and heavy space fluctuations.
Everyone filed on board.
"Yiren, let's go up and chat."
Ji Linglong turned sideways and made a gesture of invitation to Jiang Yiren.
Jiang Yiren's moon-white dress was spotless, but her eyes fell on Ji Linglong's face like frost.
The eyes were as sharp as swords, with undisguised questioning and a hint of cold anger.
The aura around her became calmer.
Ji Linglong endured the piercing gaze, her expression remained calm, but the fingers in her sleeves were slightly curled up.
After all, Jiang Yiren did not have an attack on the spot.
Without saying a word, she tapped her toes, and her figure floated onto the cloud ship like a drifting cloud.
Ji Linglong followed closely behind.
After boarding the cloud ship, Ji Linglong led Jiang Yiren towards the cabin.
And just when the two were about to step into the main cabin door.
Ji Linglong's steps paused imperceptibly, and her back instantly straightened.
The fingertips of Jiang Yiren's hand under the moon-white long sleeves also trembled slightly.
The lines on their faces seemed to soften for a moment under the faint blue light. There was an ecstatic light flashing deep in their eyes, but it was forcibly suppressed in the flash of lightning, as if it had never appeared before.
They didn't even exchange glances, but continued to move forward without any disorder, and their figures disappeared into the shadows behind the hatch.
